description: This file defines the I18NTranslationAPI class, which provides API endpoints for retrieving internationalization (i18n) translation data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for fetching paginated, filtered lists of translations, with associated validation rules and detailed OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: I18NTranslationAPI
classes.description: API class for managing internationalization translation retrieval. Provides methods to list all translations with filtering, sorting, and pagination, conforming to OpenAPI specifications. Implements collection endpoint functionality and uses localization services for data access.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of translations filtered by parameters such as language ID, source text, translated text, group ID, and whether only translated entries should be included. Returns data encapsulated in EndpointCollectionResult.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the GET request parameters, including type constraints and required fields, ensuring correct API usage.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Not implemented: intended for creating new translations.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Not implemented: intended to validate creation requests.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented: intended for deleting translations.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented: intended for validating delete requests.
